name: Stahlzeit: Zeitlos 20 Jubiläumstour
description: Rammstein tribute show with full pyro, 20th anniversary tour
details:
Stahlzeit is one of the biggest Rammstein tribute shows in Europe and celebrates its 20th anniversary with the "Zeitlos 20" tour. The listing promises large-scale staging and pyrotechnics in a show of about two and a half hours, with a crew of around 30 people.

Tickets are sold via Eventim (https://www.eventim.de/noapp/event/21322127/). The official Stahlzeit and Maimarkt Club sites could not be read, so the date comes from mvp.de only; one reseller names the Maimarkthalle instead of the Maimarkt Club - check the ticket before going.
